entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou pèdi chemen w?" t="Are you lost or what?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Fé atansyon kote w prale!" t="Watch where you're going!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Fé atansyon kote w prale!" t="Uită-te pe unde mergi!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Alo. Se mwen." t="Hi. It's me." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Alo. Se mwen." t="Salut. Sunt eu." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Gen yon fèt. Wap vini…? Ou konnen kote' monsieur... Jacked and Coke." t="There's a party. You goin'…? You know where…! Of course…! At Jacked and Coke." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Gen yon fèt. Wap vini…? Ou konnen kote' monsieur... Jacked and Coke." t="E o petrecere. Mergi…? Știi unde…! Desigur…! La Jacked and Coke." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ann aleee… M vle di …! Ou toujou sou travay, ou pa jan m sou plezi … Se sa…! Ha, ha!" t="Aw, c'mon… I mean…! All work and no play… Right…! Ha, ha!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ann aleee… M vle di …! Ou toujou sou travay, ou pa jan m sou plezi … Se sa…! Ha, ha!" t="Hai, mă… Adică…! Numai muncă și nicio distracție… Așa e…! Ha, ha!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Na wè!" t="See you!" b="" a=""/>
